_comment: Optional. Copy to config.json only if you need it. The panel normally attaches to whatever MT5 terminal is already open and logged in — no credentials required.
_phone_note: Set 'lan' to true and pick a strong 'panel_password' to reach the panel from your phone. Keep it on a private network such as Tailscale — never port-forward this to the open internet.
_credentials_note: login/password/server below are the MT5 ACCOUNT credentials, and are only needed if you want the panel to log the terminal in itself. Leave them out otherwise — config.json is git-ignored, but a file on disk is still a file on disk.
